caption.title: | Design, screening and profiling of SBI-553 analogs.
caption.p: (A) Surface and close-up views of SBI-553 bound to the NTSR1 intracellular allosteric pocket. Key residues shaping four interaction microdomains are annotated.

(B) β-arrestin2 recruitment assay for SBI-553. Left, reporter output (RLU) comparing vehicle and SBI-553 (5 μM) under indicated component combinations. Right, concentration–response curve for SBI-553. Data are presented as mean ± s.e.m. from three independent experiments.

(C) Intrinsic agonism profiling across β-arrestin2 and G-protein pathways (Gq, Gi, GoA, G12, G13) for NTS8–13, SBI-553 and representative analogs. Responses are shown as concentration–response curves (four-parameter sigmoidal curves) normalized to the maximal response of NTS8–13 within each pathway. Data are presented as mean ± s.e.m. from three independent experiments.
(D) Radar summaries of efficacy (% of NTS8–13) and pEC50 across pathways for each ligand.

caption.title: | Quantization of allosteric modulation by fitting the allosteric model across pathways.
caption.p: (A) Concentration scheme for 5 allosteric ligands.

(B–G) Allosteric operational model fits to NTS8–13 concentration–response curves in the presence of increasing concentrations of intracellular ligands across pathways: (B) Gq, (C) Gi, (D) GoA, (E) G12, (F) G13, (G) β-arrestin2. ND indicates parameters not determined due to insufficient measurable modulation/response within the fitted conditions. Data are normalized to the maximal response of NTS8–13 in each pathway and presented as mean ± s.e.m. from three independent experiments.

caption.title: | Ligand-specific interaction fingerprints of NTS8–13 and allosteric modulators in NTSR1.
caption.p: (A) Interaction fingerprint map of NTS8–13 interactions in NTSR1 structures bound to SBI-553, N065, or N191, compared with the BAM-absent control structure (PDB: 6UP7). Interactions conserved across all four structures are shown in blue, whereas interactions unique to individual structures are shown in orange. Gray circles indicate the absence of contact. Solid outlines denote hydrogen-bond interactions, dashed outlines denote π-cation interactions, and circles without outlines denote hydrophobic interactions.

(B–D) Comparison of key NTS-receptor interactions across the four NTSR1 structures. From left to right, close-up views show specific NTS–NTSR1 interactions in the BAM-absent, SBI-553-bound, N065-bound, and N191-bound structures, respectively.
(E) Interaction fingerprint map of the intracellular allosteric pocket for SBI-553, N065, and N191.
(F) Structural views illustrating a conserved polar anchoring interaction centered on R1663.50 and the adjacent Y3647.53 region within the intracellular pocket across the three modulators.
(G) Close-up of N065 showing a ligand-specific short contact between its fluorine substituent and N3607.49, consistent with a halogen-bonding geometry.

In panels (B–D), structures are arranged from left to right as BAM (–), SBI-553, N065, and N191; panels (F–G) follow the same color scheme. The orthosteric peptide and allosteric ligands are shown as sticks.

caption.title: | Allosteric ligands shape distinct phospho-landscapes and drive allosteric remodeling.
caption.p: (A) Representative phospho-kinase array membranes for vehicle, NTS8–13, SBI-553 and NTS8–13 + SBI-553.

(B) Semi-quantitative heatmap of selected nodes (relative to vehicle). Phosphorylation levels were quantified using Image J, normalized relative to the vehicle. Red represents phosphorylation, and blue represents dephosphorylation. “+” indicates an enhancement of NTS8–13 activity due to the introduction of SBI-553, and “-” indicates a weakening of NTS8–13 activity due to the introduction of SBI-553.
(C) Phosphoproteomics workflow.
(D) Sample–sample Pearson correlation matrix with hierarchical clustering, assessing within-group reproducibility and between-group separation.

(E) Left, single-agent phospho-signatures (Top350 sites; row-scaled log2 intensities). Right, remodeling heatmap under the NTS background (Top300 sites; Δlog2 intensity) with definitions: Δ= [NTS + BAM] − [NTS]; Interaction = Δ − ([BAM] − [veℎicle]), allowing separation of additive ligand effects from non-additive allosteric effects.
(F) Venn diagram of differential phosphosites for NTS+BAM versus NTS, highlighting a shared core and ligand-specific branches. Differential sites were defined as |log2FC| > 1.2 and p < 0.05.

(G) SBI-553-referenced volcano plots showing differential phosphosites between allosteric conditions under an NTS background, with representative sites annotated. The x-axis shows log2FC and the y-axis shows –log10(p value). Significant phosphosites were defined as |log2FC| > 1.2 and p < 0.05.

(H) KSEA rewiring map: x-axis, KSEA z-score (NTS+SBI-553 vs NTS); y-axis, KSEA z-score (NTS+N065 vs NTS); color indicates Δ z-score. Only kinase sets with at least five matched substrate sites were included (m ≥5 and p < 0.05). Representative kinases are annotated to illustrate differential kinase-program remodeling across allosteric ligands.

KEGG enrichment bubble plot showing significantly enriched pathways from the differential phosphoproteins in NTS+N065 vs NTS+SBI-553. The x-axis indicates rich factor, bubble size indicates the number of hits, and color indicates adjusted significance (padj).
